patterns.note: The main content area is an immersive, full-bleed grid layout where product and lifestyle photography dominates the visual space without traditional content blocks or distinct sections.
Minimalist, clean sans-serif typography is used for all UI elements (navigation, body text, buttons), allowing the vibrant product photography to be the primary visual focus.

A restrained UI color palette of off-white and black, with a single bright yellow accent, is designed to provide a neutral canvas that highlights the diverse and vibrant colors within the product photography.

The header remains sticky at the top, providing persistent navigation. The initial hero image seamlessly gives way to a continuous, deep scroll of a full-bleed, dynamic photo grid, creating an experience of ongoing visual discovery rather than discrete content sections.

The homepage is structured as a single, continuous visual narrative delivered through a dynamic image grid, rather than segmented into distinct content sections, with only a clear footer at the very end.

technique_notes: The site features a sticky header that remains visible throughout the scroll. The main content area transitions from an initial minimalist hero image to an expansive, full-bleed grid of product and lifestyle photography that continuously reveals new visuals as the user scrolls, creating an immersive visual journey rather than distinct content sections.

design_tokens.type_scale: A balanced type scale with a clean, legible sans-serif for body and navigation, and a slightly bolder, more distinctive sans-serif for the brand logo, maintaining a minimalist feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced, with an airy initial hero transitioning to a dense, full-bleed image grid.

standout: The primary standout is the complete reliance on a full-bleed, dynamic, and visually rich product photography grid as the main content and navigation, foregoing traditional section layouts for a continuous visual scroll experience.
